text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I watched your training.
You seem to be working reasonably hard.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I don't dislike seeing you work hard.
Keep up the good work.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
—However,
please make sure not to take your eyes off them.
